fusions.name: Planted Pavise
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Dropped Guard
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Held Against Arrows
fusions.desc: Increases your armour by 25% and your piercing resistance by 20% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Ward the Shot
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you gain a ward that absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
